items.headline: Alphabet shares drop about 10% after Q3 earnings while Microsoft rises
items.summary: Alphabet reported Q3 2026 results after the Oct 28 close. Per the CNBC headline, the stock dropped 10% in the after-hours/pre-market session while Microsoft rose after its own earnings; a separate CNBC live-blog headline says Nasdaq-100 futures fell more than 1% as Alphabet sold off. Result details (revenue, cloud, capex, cash flow) were not retrieved from Alphabet's release or an allowed article this run, so they are not stated.
